page.title: Calibrate
page.subtitle: Configure module routing, the camera scan region, and servo calibration

moduleCountStepper.label: Sorting modules
moduleCountStepper.description: How many physical sorting modules are wired up. Changes the number of bins available and the sections below.

reduceConfirm.title: Reduce module count?
reduceConfirm.description: Dropping to {{count}} modules will permanently delete the sorting rules and calibration data for modules and bins beyond that count, across every bin preset. This can't be undone.

channelLayoutToggle.label: Servo Channel layout
channelLayoutToggle.standardDescription: Module 1 starts at channel 0. Supports up to 5 modules.
channelLayoutToggle.legacyDescription: Module 1 starts at channel 4 (channels 0-3 reserved for status LEDs). Supports up to 3 modules. Use this if your hardware was wired before module expansion was added.
channelLayoutToggle.legacyBanner: You're on the legacy channel layout, capped at 3 modules. Rewire module 1 to start at channel 0 to support up to 5 modules.

feederCalibrationPanel.heading: Feeder
feederCalibrationPanel.speedTooltip: How fast and which way the feeder motor spins. 0% is stopped; drag either way to speed up in that direction.
feederCalibrationPanel.settleDurationDescription: Extra time to keep feeding once the module 1 sensor sees the last card in the hopper, so it travels all the way into the mechanism before the motor stops.

irSensorPanel.label: IR Sensors
irSensorPanel.tooltip: Infrared sensors that detect when a card is present at each module's feed path
irSensorPanel.monitorTooltip: Continuously poll the IR sensors and update the badges below in real time
irSensorPanel.readTooltip: Take a single snapshot reading of the IR sensors
irSensorPanel.detectedTooltip: A card is currently detected at Module {{module}}'s IR sensor
irSensorPanel.notDetectedTooltip: No card currently detected at Module {{module}}'s IR sensor
irSensorPanel.hopperTooltip: Whether the card hopper's IR sensor currently detects cards waiting to be fed

moduleCalibrationGrid.noPositionSelected: Select a position above to edit it
moduleCalibrationGrid.percentSliderTooltip: How far this servo is pushed, as a percent of its full range of motion. Select a position above, then drag this slider to change it - it's saved along with everything else when you hit Save.
moduleCalibrationGrid.rawPulseTooltip: Raw servo pulse position (120-490), the exact value sent to the device.
moduleCalibrationGrid.testServoTooltipGate: Test: briefly opens the gate, then returns it to closed, so you can watch it move.
moduleCalibrationGrid.testServoTooltipPusher: Test: briefly fires the pusher left, then right, then returns it to neutral, so you can watch it move both ways.
moduleCalibrationGrid.pusherOffsetWarning: More than {{percent}}% away from neutral — the risk of skipping gears or the horn shifting on the shaft goes up the further out you push it.
moduleCalibrationGrid.paddleCloseDelayDescription: How long after the pusher fires before this module's paddle closes again, independent of the pusher's own return timing. Longer if cards aren't fully clear before the gate shuts.

scanRegionCalibrationPanel.instructions: Drag the box to move it, or drag the handle to resize. Line it up with a card sitting at module 1.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.liveDetectionHint: The dashed box is the fallback crop used when live detection can't find the card - it's what you're editing. The solid outline is a live preview of what detection sees.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.captureSettleDescription: How long to wait after the feeder confirms a card has arrived before capturing a frame, so the card is fully still and in focus.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.matchesNeededDescription: How many consecutive frames must agree on the same card before a scan is accepted. 1 is fastest; higher values are more reliable but slower.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.executionProviderDescription: Which backend runs the card-detection and matching models in your browser. Auto prefers WebGPU when your device supports it, and falls back to WASM otherwise.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.takePhotoPrompt: Take a photo from your phone to position the box.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.phoneCaptureFailed: Phone didn't respond with a photo in time.

toasts.notCalibratedDescription: Configure all three modules before running the test sequence.
toasts.importInvalid: That file isn't a valid calibration export
toasts.saveCalibrationFailed: Failed to save the scan region or capture settle delay
